messages:
mike_release: kicking off tenant_profiles migration now — migrator v2 (rate=200r/s) pinned for this window. will run schema change + staged patch, backfill in small batches. deploybot will post progress. please watch p99 and lock counts.

deploybot: [migration-runner] started job job-782 on shard-2. acquiring lease...

rita_sql: quick Q — are we using FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED for the backfill? any risk of long held exclusive locks?

mike_release: yes SKIP LOCKED. batch_size=5000, sleep_ms=150 between batches. we should be safe but watch for rows_with_locks > 25.

devex_sam: add rollback trigger: if rows_with_locks > 50 OR replica_lag > 30s OR error_rate > 0.5% for 3 minutes, abort and pin to previous model v1.8

sre_cheryl: +1 on rollback triggers. Also set read-only flag for affected endpoint if p99 > 1.0s for 5m.

maria_docs: I'll update release notes and runbook: include exact rollback commands and canary shard list.

deploybot: [migration-runner] progress: 12% complete, 42 batches processed, current p95=120ms, replica_lag=4s

rita_sql: monitoring query I'm running:
```sql
SELECT now(), count(*) FILTER (WHERE migrated=false) as remaining, max(lock_count) FROM migration_progress WHERE job='tenant_profiles_1745';
```

mike_release: good. handover to @sre_cheryl at 10:15 if everything looks green. final check list: release notes done, pinned services (v2-2026-03), canary shards: shard-0, shard-2

devex_sam: noted — I'll post rollback snippet in the runbook section:
```bash
# rollback snippet
deployctl pin-service profiles:v1.8 && deployctl abort-job job-782 --force
```

sre_cheryl: watching metrics; will escalate if any thresholds cross. :eyes:

mike_release: thanks everyone. callout: if we need emergency abort, use the escape-hatch channel and mention @oncall-db
